data.name: Yogender
data.gender_notes: Yogender is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Yogender is a name of Sanskrit and Hindi origin meaning 'Discipline, Union with God'. It is derived from the roots 'yuj' meaning 'to unite or join' and 'andh' meaning 'male'. The name signifies a person who is deeply committed to the spiritual path and strives to attain union with the divine. The name Yogender carries the meaning “Discipline, Union with God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Yogender usually hope their child will grow to embody discipline, union with god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Yogender is a name that resonates with the deepest spiritual aspirations of an individual. It is a name that symbolizes the union of the individual soul with the divine soul, and the pursuit of self-realization and enlightenment through the practice of yoga and meditation.
data.etymology: Yogender belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Discipline, Union with God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yogender total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

historical_references.reference: Yogendra Shastri was a prominent Indian independence activist and scholar. He was a disciple of Mahatma Gandhi and Lokmanya Tilak. He played a significant role in the Indian Independence Movement, particularly in the Non-Cooperation and Quit India movements.
